purpose: 기사(차량) 화면의 휴대폰 시안. 태블릿이 없을 때 휴대폰으로 같은 일을 할 수 있게, pos-rest-v1의 기사 태블릿 화면(D01~D03)과 같은 디자인을 세로 한 줄로 옮긴다.

frame.why: 작은 안드로이드폰(360×800)에서 브라우저 주소창이 보일 때의 표시 영역. 가장 빡빡한 조건이며, 화면이 더 길면 줄 수만 늘어난다(쪽 나눔은 높이로 계산).

generation.order: wave 1 = D11 기준 화면 → 직접 검수 → wave 2 = D11의 job id를 첫 참조로 넣어 D12 · D13 · D14

references.note: 이 묶음에서 먼저 만든 기준 화면 D11의 job id는 검수 뒤에 채웠다. 제출에 쓴 값 그대로다.

screens.title: 기사 휴대폰 · 차량 운행
screens.note: 휴대폰 기준 화면. 한 줄에 업무 하나, 오른쪽에 보라 '업무 처리'. 360×640에서 4줄 + 쪽수.
screens.prompt:
High-fidelity UI design mockup of one screen of 스키노트, a web app for a Korean ski rental shop. This is the DRIVER screen used on a SMARTPHONE in the delivery van, held upright. The screen is shown flat and straight-on and fills the whole portrait canvas edge to edge: no phone body, no bezel, no notch, no status bar, no browser chrome, no hands, no perspective. Design frame 360×640 px portrait (the visible area of a small Android phone while the browser address bar is showing), so everything is large, nothing is cut off at any edge and nothing scrolls.
Use the attached reference image(s): they show the TABLET version of this same driver screen. Keep the visual system IDENTICAL and adapt only the layout to one narrow column: page background #F4F4F2, white rows and cards with 16px radius and a 1px hairline #E3E3E3, near-black text #1A1A1A, gray text #5D5D5D, accent purple #5F33E1 for the active chip and the solid primary buttons (white bold text), NO orange anywhere; status colors always paired with a text label (red #B42318, amber #B45309, green #247A3D, blue #0074D9); Pretendard-like Korean sans-serif; simple 2px Lucide-like line icons. There is NO left rail and no side panel. Side padding is 16px.
Sizes for older drivers: smallest text 16px, body 18px, names and titles 22px bold, key numbers 32px bold, every touch target at least 52px tall, the primary button 64px tall. On this 360px-wide frame a 16px Korean character is about 1/22 of the screen width and a 22px character about 1/16 of it: draw the text at that real size and do NOT shrink it to fit more on a line. Never use an ellipsis or clipped text, and never show a half-cut row.
All UI text is Korean and must be rendered crisp and spelled EXACTLY as written below. No English UI labels, no lorem ipsum, no watermark, no annotations, no extra screens, only ONE phone screen.
Screen: 차량 운행 (the driver's job list).
Header 56px, white with a bottom hairline: at the left the purple 16px bold wordmark 스키노트 and the bold 22px title "차량 운행"; at the right a white outlined square bell button 48px with a red badge 3, and a white outlined button "나가기" 48px tall with a door icon.
Chips row 60px: three filter chips 52px tall with 16px bold labels: solid purple "오늘·이전 7", white "내일 0", white "달력" with a calendar icon.
Pager row 56px: at the left 16px gray text "1호 차량 · 남은 7건"; at the right a compact pager: white outlined square button "‹" 52px, 18px text "1 / 2쪽", white outlined square button "›" 52px.
List: exactly four white rows, each 88px tall, full width, 8px gaps. In each row the left side has three lines: line 1 in 22px bold "시간 · 팀"; line 2 a small job-type badge (16px bold on a tinted background) followed by the place in 16px gray; line 3 the items in 16px gray. The right side of the row is a solid purple button 64px tall and about 96px wide with the white 18px bold label "업무 처리".
Row 1: "09:00 · 김민재 팀"; blue badge "배달" then "만선 광장"; "스키 2 · 의류 1". Row 2: "09:40 · 박서윤 팀"; blue badge "배달" then "설천 주차장"; "스키 2 · 의류 1". Row 3: "10:20 · 이도윤 팀"; blue badge "배달" then "만선 티롤 앞"; "보드 2 · 의류 1". Row 4: "16:30 · 김영희 팀"; amber badge "수거" then "만선 티롤 앞"; "스키 2 · 의류 2 · 헬멧 1".
Footer 72px, white with a top hairline: two white outlined buttons of equal width side by side, 56px tall with 18px bold labels: "차량 보관" and "최신 업무 확인". There is no solid purple button in the footer; the purple action is on each row.

screens.note: 한 팀의 전달 수량을 큰 −/+ 로 고르고, 맨 아래 폭 전체 보라 버튼으로 확정.
